heuristics.extrapolation: Historical 15-column scans and the inherited eight-column panels support the uniformity premise. Current 13-column semantic controls, the complete census and the base's 14-column controls are in Appendix U. Finite parity does not prove H1 or deep acceptance.
heuristics.limitations: A premise about the 38-step first-block compression; the experiments use deterministic seed expansion and reduced sizes; full-scale runs cover seven chaining values.
heuristics.scope: Expected per_a0=8.9419116059717409...; claws/a0=160*E/2^32, C1-claws/a0=20*E/2^32, E in [23,694,709, 23,773,042]. H1 supports the postfilter law, Bernstein cap and independence across fresh first blocks. The proven walk mean bound 7 follows equal per-entry C1 mass and prefix retention; the ledger charges 6.760092 under H1W and step 3b at H3B's stopped-path mean 842.361097; vmax retains 3014; the maximum is 18/read. The five omitted relative columns (10 through 14) are fixed before outcomes.
heuristics.statement: The first blocks M0 are fresh uniform 512-bit strings and their chaining values cv = F_38(IV, M0) behave as independent uniform 256-bit values. Consequences used: (a) for every a0, F(a0) = Cc2 + a0 + k0 + h(a0) is uniform and independent of h(a0) and of the epoch's table (cv[7] enters k0 additively and nothing else; cv[6] enters h(a0) additively), and cv[0] is uniform given both; hence y = R16H[0] - r - F(a0) is uniform, a window probes with probability 170/8192, a probe makes 2600/85 reads, the expected claw count of an a0 is 160 E / 2^32 for the table's E retained entries (Lemma C), and a claw's a1 = u - h(a0) is uniform and independent of the claw event, so a claw passes C1 with probability 1/8 (proof.md Sections 3.6, 5, 6); (b) given the epoch's table, the works W_j and the success counts X_j of distinct chaining values are independent (Lemma 3, Section 7). For each retained entry separately, H1 gives 160/2^32 expected claws and 20/2^32 expected C1 claws per scanned a0. Every bucket holds a prefix of at most six lanes; weights 6,6,6,8,8,8 sum to at most 7p for population p. Thus the ordered-tree mean charge is at most 7 per C1 claw for every fixed table, without independence between lanes or conditioning cost on success.

heuristics.extrapolation: Four complete eight-column tables, 500,000 H1-uniform probes each (r=8174 and r=4401, two measured alignments, at ustart=0; r=8174 at ustart=0x9e3779b9; r=663 at ustart=0xff5baf92): ratio means 6.739121, 6.737195, 6.750949, 6.738023 (se about 0.0040), 0 lane mismatches; the charge 6.760092 is the largest 99% upper bound. Each table mean averages 5,242,880 buckets of one population law.
heuristics.limitations: Measured on four of the 2^13 x 2^32 epoch tables by Monte Carlo probes; the full-table runs omit the 5 frame-crossing reads of 156 per probe. Under H1 alone the proven bound 7 would give time_log2 76.48975.
heuristics.scope: The per C1-claw cost 24.395886... and per_a0 10.914650... (proof Section 5, Appendix A), hence wbar and Lemma 3's E[W_j | tables] <= wbar. Not used for vmax, the Lemma 2 cap or the success probability.
heuristics.statement: For every epoch table (every r in [0, 2^13) and every ustart), the mean charge of the ordered lane walk walk_lanes per C1 claw, over the H1-uniform probe position (column, row, w) and PHI, is at most 6.760092 operations. The ledger charges this mean (WALK_MEAN) in place of the proven bound 7 of H1; the exact maximum 18 per nonempty read is unchanged and stays in vmax.

heuristics.extrapolation: Two complete eight-column tables (E_HI and E_LO), 8 class-kept chaining values each, 1,225 good pairs and zero reference mismatches give pooled mean 841.992653 (se 0.089315). The largest stated per-table one-sided 99% endpoint is 842.361097.
heuristics.limitations: Declared table-transfer premise. Evidence contains 1,225 pairs on two complete tables; it does not prove the expectation for every table or every chaining value, and no independence of call count and cost is claimed.
heuristics.scope: The step-3b term of the per-C1-claw expectation, hence per_a0 8.9419116059717409..., wbar 149274.3735022410035... and Lemma 3's conditional expected-work bound. The deterministic 3014 maximum remains in vmax and OVER.
heuristics.statement: For each fixed epoch table T, with a fresh class-kept chaining value CV drawn under H1, let G_T(CV) be the number of step3b calls and S_T(CV) their total counted stopped-path work. H3B asserts E[S_T(CV) | T] <= 842.361097 E[G_T(CV) | T]. The charged source implements early stopping before later trace rows are constructed.

heuristics.extrapolation: The inherited exhaustive N12/G counts and real-word controls remain in Sections 3.7/6 and the historical archive. All 5,422 isolated native-pair checks agree with the retained predicates. The restriction retains the stated H1/H7 transfer premises.
heuristics.limitations: F7's per-chaining-value spread makes few-chaining-value measurements of the good-pair rate noisy; the expectation over a uniform chaining value is what the bound uses.
heuristics.scope: q_pf(SEL) in N_CV and the post-filter chain term of the per-C1-claw cost (24.395886 operations per C1-claw with the class, walk and step-3b mean included).
heuristics.statement: For the claws the u-table procedure finds, Pr[C1 and C2 and G and F7] = q_pf = 57,726,359,870,197 x 287,309,824 / 2^90 = 2^-16.1877, the rate enumerated exhaustively over all 2^32 words (P(C1) = 1/8, |C1 and C2| = 53,096,854, the W9 G count 57,726,359,870,197, |F7| = 287,309,824); the stage rates 1/8, 2^-6.3379, 2^-12.2857 set the mean post-filter cost. In this filing C1 is decided inside the bucket test (Lemma B''), so the procedure processes the C1-claws (one eighth of the claws) and the rates P(C2 | C1) = 8 x 53,096,854 / 2^32 and P(C2 G | C1) set the remaining chain cost; the good-pair set is unchanged (Lemma C1). With the window (Section 3.7) the G rate is the exact count over SEL, P(G | C1 C2, SEL) = 2,051,404,269,120 / (2^20 x 53,096,854) = 0.0368453386, and F7 stays at |F7|/2^32: q_pf(SEL) = 2^-15.0022. With the kept class of chaining values (H9) F7 is at the class's rate: q_pf(SEL, class) = 2^-14.1520 at F7R = 0.1205926.

heuristics.extrapolation: Registered P1/base q3 and paired runs, diagnostics and lower bounds remain in Section 9 and historical P/Q. No new rare-event measurement is substituted. The independent current-minimum calculation confirms K*p_max<2^-28.
heuristics.limitations: Participant-run sequential Monte Carlo with a heavy-tailed middle stage; the deep rows (about 2^-71 per good pair) are represented through the declared transfer premises; premises (a) and (b) transfer beyond the measured P1 components (sensitivity of (a): up to about 0.37 bit of time_log2 if the gain were absent); the u-table's retention weighting of u is covered by H7.
heuristics.scope: q3r, hence N_CV and the whole attack term; the upper form (c) only bounds the second-order factor (1 - 2^-25) of the epoch argument (proof.md Section 7, Lemma T).
heuristics.statement: A good pair of the u-table procedure is accepted by step 3b with probability q3r >= q3_P1 x 2^32 / 160 = 2^-71.4010, where q3_P1 = 2^-96.0791 = q3_model x 2^D_LB: q3_model = 2^-96.0133 is the registered accepted-event rate of the A0-variant good pairs on P8 before row 16 and D_LB = -0.0658 is the registered one-sided 99% lower bound of the paired per-seed difference L(P1) - L(A0) measured with the P1 law of the window W9 = [9 x 2^26, 10 x 2^26) (a0 uniform in W9 given G, a1 uniform on C1 and C2). Every a0 the procedure scans lies in W9 (the restriction to the sub-blocks SEL of W9 is the separate premise H8), its claws' a1 are uniform (H1) and its good pairs have the measured (a0, a1) law; their u = W1 is retained from the fixed R*=8174 residue classes under the strengthened H7 premise (Lemma S) and retained by the arc law (H7). Two inherited transfer premises are part of this heuristic and are stated in proof.md Section 9: (a) the relaxation gain (+0.41488 bit for not imposing E18 = E17), measured on the A0-variant family, is the same for the P1 family, whose paired difference D_LB was measured on the printed event; (b) q3 does not depend on the re-weighting of a1 by its G count n(a1), the difference between the R9 list law (a1 uniform on C1 and C2, then a0 given G) and the u-table's joint law. (c) For the second-order term of the epoch argument only, the average acceptance a-bar of good pairs with uniform W1 is at most 2^10 q3r = 2^-61.40 (the one-sided 99% upper readings of the same registered runs give 2^-70.88). Lemma T then bounds the acceptance of every table's good pairs by 2^6.8013 a-bar, because each table holds at least 38,510,323 of the 2^32 words and acceptance is nonnegative.

heuristics.extrapolation: The inherited registered estimator, confidence interpretation and limitations remain in Section 9 and historical P/Q/R. No finite current check validates a probability near 2^-96.
heuristics.limitations: Participant-run tool, not executed by the organizer; heavy-tailed middle stage (some ratio seeds die, counted as 0); the estimator is validated on known answers and on its own reproductions, not on an independent implementation.
heuristics.scope: q3_model and D_LB, hence q3r, N_CV and the attack term (the same scope as H2-P1).
heuristics.statement: The sequential Monte Carlo estimator traillab (the lineage's own C tool, not shipped), with which q3_model and the paired difference D_LB were measured, estimates the accepted-event rate of the stated model without material bias. It replays every sample on real 38-step compressions of both members (0 replay mismatches required), treats rows 16..21 as the importance-split prefix (8,192 particles, 256 proposals per row; the row-16 stage is exact with weight 160/2^32) and counts EXACT (zero output difference after step 37) in the window rows 22..37. Its per-seed values, combined by the registered one-sided rules, give conservative bounds for the true rate.

heuristics.extrapolation: The registered 24-CV panel retains its DEPENDENCE DETECTED result, unequal-size caveat and post-hoc rate comparison in Section 8 and historical H. The restriction does not strengthen this premise.
heuristics.limitations: Not testable at the acceptance probability; components only. The 24-CV panel was not stratified by the cv0 class, and the marginal class-rate measurements (F7R, MSG_CLS on an independent pool) do not by themselves establish a factorial-moment inequality, so the class-conditioned transfer is declared, not measured.
heuristics.scope: The Bonferroni factor is the constant 1 - 2^-8.5 = 0.99723786413599... per chaining value: E[J(J-1)]/2 <= 2^-8.5 E[J], and with E[J]=NA*ca_lo*q_pf*q3r=2^-65.24 the absolute loss is 2^-73.74. The factor multiplies E[J] once and carries no E[J] inside the correction. The tighter evaluation recorded in Appendix V section support-8 (2^-61.8) is not charged because it needs a bound on E[K(K-1)]/E[K] that the premise does not supply: K = 2^20 with probability about 2^5.99/2^20 and K = 0 otherwise keeps E[K] and gives E[J(J-1)]/E[J] = q3r(2^20-1), far above 2^-61.8 and still below the declared 2^-7.5. An earlier revision wrote 1 - 2^-8.5*E[J]; that is invalid and withdrawn.
heuristics.statement: Group independence within a chaining value (the form of H5-group-independence of the accepted 44870635): good pairs of one chaining value that share no endpoint (a0 or u) are independent trials of the accepted event, each with probability q3r; good pairs sharing an endpoint form a group counted once. Consequence used: for a uniform chaining value and any table, J (accepted good pairs among all claws of the chaining value) has E[J(J-1)] <= 2^-7.5 E[J]. This filing applies the same premise to the kept-CV class ((cv0 >> 24) & 63 == 12): the class conditions only cv[0], the panel below is drawn from uniform chaining values (so about 1/64 of its CVs are in-class), and the transfer of the second-moment bound to the class-conditioned law is part of this declared premise.

heuristics.extrapolation: Section 4 and Appendix U list prices. Exact register/walk controls, the isolated actual ledger, independent rational reconstruction, 18 restriction/ledger source mutants and six isolated method mutants bind changed terms. Observations are participant evidence.
heuristics.limitations: Prices are the cost model's unit prices applied to an explicit straight-line count; the 256-bit word tests rely on the absence of carries between lanes and between the u part and the field of a lane, proved in Lemmas B' and B'' and checked on every lane class.
heuristics.scope: The whole time bound.
heuristics.statement: Under collision-frontier-v5, C=2728. Each load/store/address/arithmetic/logic/shift/immediate/random operation costs 1; compare plus branch costs 2; a branch on a zero test of a computed word costs 1 (Lemma Z: the read's Z = 0 test and three single-bit pf_tail tests); sigma costs 8 (post-filter s0 tests 6, Lemma D); folded MAJ/CH costs 2. Section 4 prices the build, the 16 random words of M0 per first block, class test, per-CV setup, 218-operation 16-register program, probe rate 170/8192, 2600/85 reads per probe, seven-operation read, walk mean 6.760092/C1 claw (H1W) and maximum 18/read, postfilter segments 13, 22 and 24, step3b mean 842.361097/good pair under H3B, with exact 3014 maximum in vmax, and one-time 2^24 initialization. No cost is inferred from wall time.

heuristics.extrapolation: Ten fresh fixed-seed controls with a local source build of Kissat 4.0.1: three satisfiable with rows decoded, two unsatisfiable and six undecided under a conflict budget, so only three exercise row decoding. In all eleven the solver read exactly the published serializer's bytes (tapped). 24 file-against-pipe solver configurations, five local PySAT builds and exact LP-dual certificates checked by two programs. The live clause objects at the end of construction were measured on seven sweep-shaped controls, each bound to its control's formula. No historical P8 run is re-executed.
heuristics.limitations: H6-D is not reproduced locally: on the experiment platform the published encoder at the end of construction exceeds 152,868 KiB (no blocks: 158,711,808 bytes anonymous, 168,951,808 resident; 5,430 blocks: 166,572,032 and 176,832,512). Appendix Z charges the recorded tail list once through its actual coexistence path. Active phase E is the released-tail model part 85,323,392 plus 4,009,984 bytes of procedure code and recorder overhead; kernel state is kernel-side and the launcher is replaced at exec. Because phase E itself sets the 131,137,536-byte submitted maximum, any positive understatement of G raises the required bound; the 1,163,232-byte difference is the amount by which phase E exceeds the online image, not understatement slack. The predecessor's signed-16 width (Lemma RE2) is withdrawn as false; the record is charged once at no more than 18,997,248 bytes as the alternative endpoint of the coexistence maximum. The recorder whole-process figures are local-platform stress values, not procedure cells. The historical Kissat 4.0.1 binary and platform are unavailable; parity uses a local source build. Fresh fixed-seed controls are not a historical reproduction. The local clause-object receipt supports H6-E(a0) but does not create certified slack for the historical execution.
heuristics.scope: Appendix W: the record bound 44,585,056 bytes, needing no Kissat premise, and the P8 cell 211,431,424, whose phases R and S use H6-D figure and the H6-E(b) allowances. Appendix Z charges the recorded list once rather than twice, dropping phase E to 131,137,536 and phase R to 157,474,816, which place phase E 1,163,232 above the image and phase R 3,072,000 below it; the charge is the counted phase maximum, phase E 131,137,536. Time, preprocessing and success are unchanged.
heuristics.statement: (a0) The 152,868 KiB encoder figure of H6-D bounds the live clause objects of the historical P8 encoder process at the end of construction (every clause list of F_hist with its item array, and the int objects outside -5..256 held by its sha256_model clauses), resident and not swapped out or compressed; these are the only objects the record and token bounds read, and R.6D does not use this reading. (a) The encoder ran on a default 64-bit CPython 3: each clause of F_hist was a distinct list of at least 56+8k bytes, each literal sdmodel.apply computed outside the small-int cache -5..256 a distinct int object of at least 26 bytes, and PySAT's CNF kept each clause as that list or a copy holding the same objects. (b) The measured P8RR allowances transfer to the historical platform: recorder overhead 2 MiB, regenerator 32 MiB, decoder 96 MiB, filter 1 MiB, launcher 4 MiB, 1 MiB kernel state per process, 1 MiB for Kissat reading a pipe, 1 MiB per pipe; retained files are rounded to 4 KiB pages. (d) Assumed: the spec was shorter than 2 MiB, as one execve argument of the published sweep allows on Linux with pages of at most 64 KiB or on macOS; it bounds the launcher's, decoder's and output's copies of the spec.

heuristics.extrapolation: GoForceX 9cdbd3c1 supplies the exhaustive fixed-table census and executable change. R*=8174 is the best of the four H1W-measured alignments, not the census argmax. Appendix AG states the exact transfer boundary.
heuristics.limitations: This is a declared strengthening of h8f's average-over-alignments H7. The historical shallow panels do not prove rows 22..37 or every alignment. If declined, the score reverts exactly to h8f 83.748439.
heuristics.scope: The success expectation at fixed R*=8174 uses exact E=23,771,164: 2^20 (160 E / 2^32) q_pf(SEL,class) 2^-0.011821 2^-0.0225 q3r. The same E prices the cost side.
heuristics.statement: The construction fixes r=8174 before outcomes and draws only ustart uniformly. The exhaustive census gives E(8174)=23,771,164; the width-8 population range is 23,694,709..23,773,042 and the true maximum for the ten-column control is at r=8150. Premise: for this fixed alignment, averaged over ustart and the chaining value, acceptance is independent of coverage class and retention, so expected accepted pairs equal expected claws times q_pf times q3r.

heuristics.extrapolation: Unique seeds 101..168, counted once: 1,700,000,000 pairs per side, SEL profile 257,983 and W9 profile 258,427. Point log2 ratio -0.0024808069401957883, SE 0.004014896826580175, one-sided 99% lower bound -0.011820853637039925, charged at -0.011821 (six decimals, still below the exact bound). This updates only the message-side input of H8; it does not establish rows 22..37 state invariance.
heuristics.limitations: Rows 22..37 of the state part are not directly measurable at the claimed probability; H8 is the premise covering exactly that gap, supported by the exact message-side counts, the shallow-row panels and the unchanged registration, not by a measurement of the deep event. If it failed, the bound would move with the state part on the selected good pairs.
heuristics.scope: The state-side H8 premise, geometry, q_pf and every other premise are unchanged from the public parent; the measured message-side charge is tightened from the four-decimal floor -0.0119 to -0.011821 (still below the exact 99% lower bound -0.011820853637039925), which moves the ledger and N_CV.
heuristics.statement: Given the message-difference profile of a good pair, the inherited H8 state part is unchanged between SEL and W9. The measured message part is charged: the window's good pairs are accepted with probability at least 2^-0.011821 q3r, using the unique-seed pooled panel's one-sided 99% lower bound; the inherited registered upper form a-bar <= 2^10 q3r remains unchanged.

heuristics.extrapolation: The class F7 rate 0.1205926 (upper 0.1206112) and message factor 2^-0.0225 were measured on pools independent of the class selection, with a second pool for F7R and MSG_CLS, so both factors are post-selection-independent measurements; the class is a 2^-6 cv0 condition with three charged operations per first block. The rows 17..21 panels are in Appendix T; the 64-class search, rates, paired evidence and bounds remain in Section 3.8 and Appendix V. Finite controls do not establish rows 16..37 invariance.
heuristics.limitations: Rows 16..37 of the state part are not directly measurable at the claimed probability; H9 covers that gap, supported by the independent-pool class rates, the balanced 64-class search and the shallow-row panels rather than by a measurement of the deep event. The F7 rate is the one-sided 99% bound of the exhaustive-density Rao-Blackwell estimator, 0.1206019 +- 0.0000031 over 3.21e7 X-samples, whose exact control (equal-weight mean over the 256 byte-classes) returns 0.066894531 against 0.06689453125.
heuristics.scope: Inherited historical sensitivity/comparison only: q_pf and q3r in N_CV and the step-3b cost term: the class raises q_pf by 0.1205926 / 0.0668945 = 2^0.8413 and, after the charged message factor and the class test (3 operations per first block), gives time_log2 76.7653 (without the class: 77.5450; 8116a55c: 77.1297).
heuristics.statement: Only first blocks whose chaining value is in the class ((cv0 >> 24) & 63) == 12 are kept (2^-6 of them; proof.md Section 3.8).
